hints: latency is poorly explained by input length (R2 0.23, n 24, tokens 86-106) -> shorter input is not a reliable speed-up
model forward is 100% of decision time (median tokenise 11.7 / forward 2349.3 / post 0.1 ms; shares 0%/100%/0%) -> only fewer tokens or a faster model will help; glue code is not the bottleneck
choice changed under reversed order in 3/12 cases (25%) -> order bias; average over orders or fix the order
phrasing: direct 8 decisions, indirect 8 decisions, narrative 8 decisions -> too few to judge (need >= 10 decisions in at least two phrasings)
peak RAM 4138 MiB is 55% of device RAM (7468 MiB) -> only one such model can stay resident
